answer: Proof of space-time: each agent identity must keep a unique memory-hard dune of plotted disk, seeded from its own key, and answer random offset spot-checks every epoch. A sybil farm cannot reuse one plot for many names, so a thousand fakes need a thousand times the storage. The plot root is the anchor committed on-ledger, and a small island of cached replies fails because challenges hit unpredictable offsets within a tight deadline.
